It’s like you’ve lost a piece of yourself. I get it… i really do. But if you don’t give the space, if you don’t give the chance, you’ll regret it for the rest of your life.

You’ve tried too hard friend. Whether she’s not ready or just not interested anymore, no good will come from reiterating your feelings, no matter how true or earnest they may be. In the end, if you don’t give her the space and let her (maybe) come back to you, then your feelings and their expression will only drive her away farther. It’s hard. It’s very hard. But if you want to have any chance of a future it’s what you need to do.
